use_when: A comment keyword starts a booking conversation with an explicit soon/not-yet question.
avoid_when: Do not choose when qualification requires several facts or open-ended AI interpretation.
Do not silently drop an essential unsupported gate.
required_facts: Post and keyword, binary qualification rule, booking link and human notification owner.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.
